name: AbstentionBench
intro: AbstentionBench 是面向模型选择性拒答能力的综合基准。作者从 82 个候选数据集系统筛选出 16 个通用数据集，并加入 3 个删除关键上下文的推理变体和 UMWP，形成覆盖 6 类拒答场景、超过 35,000 个不可回答问题的 20 数据集套件。评测用经人工验证的 Llama 3.1 8B 判分器识别拒答并判断非拒答回答的正确性。
build_method: 82个候选系统筛选, 16个通用集整理, 3个缺失上下文变体+UMWP
metric: Abstention Recall（核心）, Precision, F1, Response Accuracy
task_type: 拒答评测, 不确定性推理
eval_feature: 拒答能力, 不确定性推理, 不可回答问题
scale: 20个数据集, 超过35,000个不可回答问题, 6类场景
build_method_en: Systematic screening of 82 candidates, 16 curated general sets, 3 context-removed variants plus UMWP
intro_en: AbstentionBench is a holistic benchmark of selective abstention. The authors systematically screen 82 candidate datasets, retain 16 general-domain datasets, and add three reasoning variants with key context removed plus UMWP, yielding a 20-dataset suite with more than 35,000 unanswerable questions across six scenarios. Human-validated Llama 3.1 8B judges detect abstention and score the correctness of non-abstention responses.
scale_en: 20 datasets, more than 35,000 unanswerable questions, 6 scenarios
metric_en: Abstention Recall (primary), Precision, F1, Response Accuracy
drawio_review_note: REDRAW reviewed against arXiv:2506.09038v1 Sections 3.1-3.4 and Appendix E plus official facebookresearch/AbstentionBench snapshot e29184174c69bc95139b8c33dcca09aacab9442a. Sixteen retained general datasets, three constructed -Abstain variants, and UMWP merge as parallel inputs into the 20-dataset, more-than-35,000-question suite. The abstention judge branches first; only a non-abstaining response with an available reference reaches the correctness judge.
